content.text:
## Welcome to Building Incident Management Teams

You will get the practical version, not fluff.

# Teach Me Like I'm 10

Building Incident Management Teams in plain English: understand the moving parts, spot the failure points, and use them well.

## Core concepts

- Team composition
- skills needed
- team size

Keep it simple. Map the idea, then apply it.

# Hands-on exercise

Write a short checklist or script that applies the lesson in a safe lab setting.

# Real-world

Use Building Incident Management Teams to solve a real operational problem, not just to memorize terms.

# Memory aid

Use one sentence, one diagram, one quick recall drill.

# Reflection

What changed in how you think about the problem? What would you do tomorrow?

## Wrap-up

If you can explain Building Incident Management Teams simply, you actually know it.
